verdicts.title: Enumerative tropical algebraic geometry in R2
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
The paper establishes a formula for enumeration of curves of arbitrary genus in toric surfaces. It turns out that such curves can be counted by means of certain lattice paths in the Newton polygon. The formula was announced earlier in http://arxiv.org/abs/math.AG/0209253.

verdicts.title: Some NP Complete Problems Based on Algebra and Algebraic Geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This paper describes several new problems and ideas concerning algebraic geometry and complexity theory.
